The '''liberation''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vilosoria]] occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The native [[Vilosorian]]s were able to drive the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Background==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2z-DL]] was used as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] deep undercover behind enemy lines, tracking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] movement near the planet [[Vilosoria]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[File:R2Z-DL-CRO.png|thumb|left|200px|[[R2z-DL|Toozy]].]]
When traveling the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]], Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Koedi Raef]] discovered a hidden data packet in the memory banks of her [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] from R2z-DL, nicknamed Toozy. It contained information relating to the Imperial presence in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] and on the [[Vilosorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and their seasonal cycles.<ref name="CRO" />

==The liberation==
Using this data, Raef was able to facilitate the liberation of Vilosoria. She managed to have the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Fireclaw]]'' delayed and Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] troops, lacking reinforcements, were defeated by the the native Vilosorians, who, with the coming of the warm seasons, had metamorphosized into powerful carnivores.<ref name="CRO" />

==Aftermath==
As a result Koedi Raef was awarded the [[Rohal Cross]] for successful liberation of the planet, but the pilot refused it and gave it to Toozy.<ref name="CRO" />
